title: What is Artificial Intelligence
content: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the simulation of human intelligence in machines that are programmed to think, learn, and make decisions.

title: Types of Artificial Intelligence
content: AI is classified into Narrow AI, General AI, and Super AI based on capabilities.

title: Machine Learning
content: Machine Learning is a subset of AI that enables systems to learn from data without being explicitly programmed.

title: Deep Learning
content: Deep Learning uses neural networks with multiple layers to perform complex tasks such as image and speech recognition.

title: Retrieval Augmented Generation
content: RAG combines document retrieval with language models to generate grounded and accurate responses.

title: Why RAG is Important
content: RAG reduces hallucinations by grounding LLM outputs in external knowledge sources like CSV and PDF files.
